summary: Feed s086_single is degraded: required VLAN 20 is missing (50% of packets untagged) causing NDR blind spot. All other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or upstream SPAN/trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20 - 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is never seen despite NDR requiring VLANs 10 and 20. Most likely broker VLAN handling set to strip/remove tags or trunk pruning missing VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 and cannot correctly segment/attribute the 50% untagged traffic, reducing detection coverage by ~50% and missing lateral movement or VLAN-specific attacks.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving 802.1Q tags and ensuring trunk/broker forwards both required VLANs restores complete VLAN visibility the NDR needs for accurate detection and segmentation.
